# Inverted pyramid

## Directives

From [Digital product development](digital-product-development.md):

- Name the user and the task of each feature before you design or build the feature. ^name-user-and-task

## Definition

A structure that puts the most important information, often the conclusion, first, and the supporting details after it. It comes from journalism. Nielsen Norman Group recommends it for the web, because a reader who reads only one paragraph still gets the main point.
